  "version" INTEGER NOT NULL,

label: Create table social_account
summary: Creates table social_account with required columns

precheck.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) = 0 AS "result" FROM "sqlite_master" WHERE ("type" = ? AND "name" = ?)

execute.sql:
CREATE TABLE "social_account" (
  "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "icon" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "imageUrl" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "label" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "position" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "settingId" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "url" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("settingId") REFERENCES "site_setting" ("id") ON DELETE CASCADE
)
